composition_subtypes.role: Compute f via XOR pyramid DP
Compute max over intervals via DP

payload.core_composition_summary: Two-stage DP: first compute XOR pyramid for f values, then propagate maximums over subsegments using interval DP.
payload.rationale: Solution combines two distinct dynamic programming passes: building a 2D XOR table to calculate f for all subsegments, then a second DP to precompute maximum f values for all intervals.
